name: Nether Star: Harbinger

pages.text: In singleplayer use on an inactive Harbinger; one star is consumed.

pages.title: Source and target
pages.text: The Nether Star is Wither loot. Harbinger activation is an entity interaction at the Ancient Factory, not a crafting-grid recipe.

pages.title: Conditions
pages.text: In native singleplayer combat, use the star on a still-inactive Harbinger. Survival consumes one star, activates the boss and restores its health. An already-active boss does not repeat this awakening interaction.

pages.title: Dedicated server
pages.text: Native awakening does not bypass hosted preparation: start through Start. $(l:handbook/bosses/cataclysm/the_harbinger)Arrow protection and EMP$(/l).
